# A. Rehman & Sons — Commercial Chemical Supplier & Exporter

> Premier manufacturer and imported chemical supplier in Pakistan since 1988. Specialist in Commercial Laundry, Kitchen & Stewarding, and Institutional Housekeeping Chemical Solutions.

## Quick Facts
- **Company Name:** A. Rehman & Sons (ARS)
- **Established:** 1988 (over 35 years in commercial chemical manufacturing)
- **Headquarters & Factory:** Plot # 152, Street # 1, Millat Colony, Rawalpindi, Pakistan
- **Telephone:** +92 51 5503203
- **Mobile / WhatsApp:** +92 331 8502997 / +92 333 2158113
- **Email:** ar_sons@hotmail.com
- **Official Website:** https://arschemicals.com
- **Certifications:** ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System, ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health & Safety, Halal Certified, HACCP Food Grade Compliance.
- **Export Reach:** Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman), Central Asia (Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan), and Africa. FOB Karachi Port and CIF sea freight.

## Core Capabilities & Formulations
A. Rehman & Sons manufactures 29 verified commercial chemical formulations available on wholesale quotation:

### 1. Kitchen & Stewarding Range
- **ZEPOL AB**: Heavy-duty commercial pot & dishwashing detergent. 100% biodegradable.
- **ZEKLOR S**: Destaining sanitizer for tea urns, ceramic cups, and melamine crockery.
- **DESCALER H3**: Food-grade acid descaler for commercial dishwashers and bain-maries.
- **OVEN CLEANER**: Heavy carbon and baked-on grease stripper for commercial rotisseries and grills.
- **GREASE CUTTER**: Fast-acting industrial solvent degreaser for exhaust hoods and baffle filters.
- **BIO-DETERGENT**: Multi-enzyme food-waste breakdown detergent for dishwashers and grease traps.
- **T-POL**: Multi-surface neutral liquid detergent for catering and tableware.

### 2. Commercial Laundry Range
- **ZEPOL SC 10**: Enzyme-boosted built liquid laundry detergent for blood, protein, and food stains.
- **ZEPOL SC 100**: Heavy-duty single-shot synthetic detergent liquid for chef coats and heavy soil.
- **ZEKLOR SS**: Stabilized commercial liquid chlorine bleach for hospital and hotel whites.
- **ZEKLOR O**: 130-volume oxygen color-safe bleach liquid for colored linens.
- **D-SOUR ZX**: Liquid laundry sour and anti-chlor neutralizer for the final rinse cycle.
- **SOFTENER CNA**: Cationic antistatic fabric conditioner with fresh fragrance.
- **SODA ASH**: Pure sodium carbonate washing builder for water softening.
- **NEEL**: Ultramarine optical bluing compound for snow-white finish.
- **AMROLE**: Textile auxiliary stain lifter for dye-run and cosmetic marks.
- **RUST REMOVER**: Concentrated oxalic acid rust stain eliminator.
- **ZEKLOR HARD**: Hard water sequestering agent and chelating booster.
- **STARCH**: Industrial finishing starch for crisp banquet table linen and pillowcases.
- **BLEACH POWDER**: Calcium hypochlorite powder (65–70% chlorine) for bleaching and disinfection.
- **CAUSTIC SODA**: Pure sodium hydroxide flakes for heavy saponification of kitchen grease.
- **CITRIC ACID**: Food-grade organic neutralizer sour and descaler.
- **ZEKLOR DRY**: Dry laundry compound booster for commercial wash wheels.

### 3. Housekeeping & Facility Care Range
- **CARPET SHAMPOO**: High-foam dry extraction fiber shampoo for hotel carpets.
- **G.P.C**: General Purpose Cleaner for marble, tile, vinyl, and walls.
- **HAND CLEANING SHAMPOO**: Pearlized antibacterial liquid hand soap.
- **LAVATORY / FLOOR CLEANER**: Germicidal acid toilet and floor cleaner.
- **ZEKLOR CHLORINE**: Commercial hospital surface disinfectant chlorine.
- **GLASS CLEANER**: Streak-free mirror and glass polish.
